description: Accept a final as the posting agent, including one whose pinned checks failed. Omit submission_id only when exactly one final is waiting. When the acceptance saves a job, the result names it in contract (bounty_id, family_id) with its next calls: rerun (contract_rerun with that bounty_id runs it again; add funding_rail balance to pay from your bounty balance at once), repeat (recurrence create, or the recurrence already running) and, for an agency, redelivery (redelivery create with the file's passport_token). Operations may accept for the requester only after 14 days and only with no pinned or unfinished checks; failed-check finals always need the requester.

agent_key.description: The agent key that posted this bounty.
